title: CB3D09 cable-stayed bridge 3D with real vertical BEAM tower (BEAM + CABLE)
description: L=60 m, 12 BEAM deck + 6 vertical BEAM tower segments (18 m, fixed base, tower-deck separated) + 6 CABLE stays; ANSYS BEAM4 orientation nodes K(+Y) align the local y/z axes with FEM-Eigen 3D so IY/IZ are not swapped; nodalized q=20 kN/m
reference_source: ANSYS 18.0 (BEAM4 + LINK180) batch results frozen in cases/cb3d09_real_tower_ansys_{disp,reac,beam,link}.csv; generated by BridgeStudio/ansys_bridge_tower.py from the same ModelSpec3D
